name: Additional Hypercharge
body:
You have learned to push your bonded vessel in a new way.

Prerequisite(s): Hypercharge class feature

Benefit(s): You may select an additional hypercharge from the list of helmsman hypercharges, adding it to your list of hypercharges known.
